g.text: US-04: Deviation Detection - Detector classifies each ping; Evaluator owns episode state
look up assigned reference route for entity

Stateless: classifies every eligible ping independently.
Episode state belongs entirely to the Alert Evaluator.
Subsequent OUT_OF_RANGE pings within the same
episode increment count but do not re-emit.
or already emitted for this episode
Episode reset. No alert emitted on IN_RANGE.
Next OUT_OF_RANGE starts a new episode.
